thread:
Aisha: Heads-up — GranitePay reported a ~3x jump in chat + embedding calls after launching their Agent Assist beta yesterday. Seeing p99 latency spikes on their Dedicated pool. cc @Sam @Jordan
Sam: Got it. Do we have the traffic breakdown (tokens/min, embedding units)? p99 numbers?
Aisha: Quick snapshot:
```
customer: granitepay
window: last 24h
requests: +310% vs baseline
peak RPS: 420
embedding units: +420%
latency p50/p95/p99: 35ms / 120ms / 420ms
errors: 0.3% (mostly 503/timeout)
```
Jordan: That's non-trivial. Are they on Dedicated with autoscale enabled?
Aisha: They are on Dedicated reserved pool but autoscale was intentionally capped (customer request) to keep costs predictable. Current cap x3, so bursts hit queueing.
Lina: I can run an enablement session + quick playbook. Short suggestions: prefix/KV caching for agent context, move non-critical embeddings to batched windows, and fallback to cheaper quant models for background tasks.
Sam: From infra side — we should either temporarily raise the autoscale cap or add short-lived burst pods. Also recommend enabling request-level priority for interactive flows. Ops-wise, opening a ticket to provision + monitor.
Jordan: Note: renewal in 45 days. If latency remains high customers escalate. Recommend a canary ramp: shift 10% heavy flows to burst config and monitor quality/latency for 48 hours before wider rollout.
Aisha: Proposed CS plan to present to customer: 1) 2-week burst reserve (+2 pods) 2) complimentary enablement workshop (walkthrough caching + batching) 3) model-fallback policy to cheaper quant variant for non-interactive backfill. Want eng to confirm feasibility and cost impact.
Sam: I'll open infra ticket INF-2247 and tag eng-oncall. Pricing says they can offer a one-time credit for the burst if needed to smooth renewal. :thumbsup:
Sam: infra ticket details: INF-2247 — GranitePay temporary-reserve request. Requested start: tomorrow 00:00 UTC, duration 14 days.
cs-bot: Alert created: INF-2247 — GranitePay temporary-reserve requested by Sam. (assigned: eng-oncall)
Jordan: Scheduling enablement Wed 10am PT. I'll draft the playbook and add the CS -> Eng -> Product attendees.
Lina: I'll coordinate the renewal manager and prep a short exec-facing note showing mitigation plan and KPI targets to share with the customer.
Aisha: Thanks all — I'll propose the burst + workshop to GranitePay and update this thread with their decision. If we get a thumbs-up I'll ask eng to expedite INF-2247. :rocket:
